verified_source_delta: CrispASR provides a common native C++/ggml/GGUF deployment substrate for Qwen3-ASR and Qwen3-TTS.

Default server semantics keep one loaded model and serialize inference; server workers use independent model instances and multiply model memory, so one-binary does not establish shared simultaneous ASR+TTS residency.

Audited Qwen3-ASR GGUF notes report long-audio failures when the audio encoder is quantized below Q8, changing the first compact F2 falsifier toward a Q8 audio tower rather than naive all-Q4 quantization.
